_doc: Static prop specifications. standard tris retains low-cost instancing; quality_tris is an explicit budget for prominent props. render_mode=vertex requires one vertex-colour surface; materials preserves embedded textures and solid materials. Builds are candidates until explicit validated installation. All routes must follow the stylized low-poly art direction in PRD section 9.1; technical validation does not establish style acceptance.

quality_style_prompt: Polished stylized LOW-POLY 3D game asset for Satellite Shadow, flat-shaded visibly faceted polygons, simple angular forms and clean readable silhouette, broad natural warm colour areas, restrained painted material details, simplified culturally meaningful patterns, {desc}, one isolated complete object, all extremities visible, mild orthographic front-right three-quarter view, even studio light, transparent or plain white background, no cast shadow, no people, no text, no scene dressing. Preserve structural openings and separated thin parts. Match a faceted low-poly game world: no photorealism, no dense wood grain or individual straw/fabric fibres, no noisy normal-map detail, no glossy realistic materials. Prioritize silhouette, proportions and structure over surface detail.
